About OrigRead
OrigRead is a personal information reader developed and maintained by ZGMFX01A. The project is based on the open-source Read You application and continues to comply with the GNU GPL v3 license.
Privacy
OrigRead does not operate an account server and does not actively collect, upload, sell, or share your personal data. Subscriptions, reading history, favorites, website parsing rules, AI configuration, and account credentials are stored locally on your device unless you explicitly use a third-party synchronization or AI service.
Network and third-party services
The app accesses websites, RSS services, GitHub, synchronization services, browsers, and AI providers only when required by the features you use. Those services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies. API keys and credentials are provided by you, and you are responsible for selecting trusted service providers.
Content and responsibility
OrigRead is a content aggregation and reading tool. Copyright and responsibility for third-party content belong to the corresponding websites and authors. You must comply with applicable laws, website terms, and service restrictions when subscribing to, parsing, storing, translating, or summarizing content.
Open-source attribution
This project is a derivative work based on Read You. We respect and thank the original Read You authors and contributors. Source code and issue tracking for OrigRead are available at [1]. The original Read You project is available at [2].
